FROM docker.io/library/golang:1.26-alpine AS builder
RUN apk add --no-cache git
WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY *.go ./
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o /open_taki .

FROM docker.io/library/alpine:3.20
RUN apk add --no-cache curl poppler-utils pandoc python3 py3-pip ffmpeg \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages pymupdf
# Office conversion: add collabora as sidecar container
# Audio/video: ffmpeg for whisper (webm/opus transcoding)
COPY --from=builder /open_taki /usr/local/bin/open_taki
COPY taki-embed-ocr.py /usr/local/bin/taki-embed-ocr.py
COPY taki-pdf-check.py /usr/local/bin/taki-pdf-check.py
COPY taki-vector-crop.py /usr/local/bin/taki-vector-crop.py
COPY config.yaml /etc/open_taki/config.yaml
COPY docmeta_schema.json /etc/open_taki/docmeta_schema.json
COPY docmeta_prompt.txt /etc/open_taki/docmeta_prompt.txt
COPY docmeta_rescue_prompt.txt /etc/open_taki/docmeta_rescue_prompt.txt
COPY field_rules.json /etc/open_taki/field_rules.json
COPY store_detect_prompt.txt /etc/open_taki/store_detect_prompt.txt
COPY aktenplan.txt /etc/open_taki/aktenplan.txt
EXPOSE 9998
ENTRYPOINT ["open_taki"]
CMD ["/etc/open_taki/config.yaml"]
module codeberg.org/kosmos-eu/open_taki

go 1.25.0

require (

#!/bin/bash
# deploy.sh — nuhost6 image update for a single container in a pod
#
# Usage:
#   ./deploy.sh              # deploy latest
#   ./deploy.sh 20260729-1805  # deploy specific tag
set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
. "${SCRIPT_DIR}/DIST"

TAG="${1:-latest}"
REGISTRY="${PUSH_REGISTRY:-ghcr.io}"
NS="${PUSH_NS:-kosmos-eu}"
IMAGE="${APP:-open_taki}"
FULL_IMAGE="${REGISTRY}/${NS}/${IMAGE}:${TAG}"
COMPOSE_DIR="/nu/container/${TARGET}/compose"
CONF="${COMPOSE_DIR}/compose.nuhost6.conf"

echo "=== Deploy ${IMAGE}:${TAG} to ${HOST} (target: ${TARGET}, service: ${SERVICE}) ==="

# 1. Update pin in compose.nuhost6.conf
echo "  [pin] ${SERVICE} = ${FULL_IMAGE}"
ssh "root@${HOST}" "
    sed -i 's|^${SERVICE} = .*|${SERVICE} = ${FULL_IMAGE}|' ${CONF}
"

# 2. Show diff
echo ""
echo "=== Diff ==="
ssh "root@${HOST}" "nu compose --diff ${COMPOSE_DIR}" 2>&1 || true

# 3. Apply
echo ""
echo "=== Apply ==="
ssh "root@${HOST}" "nu compose --auto-apply ${COMPOSE_DIR}" 2>&1

# 4. Restart only the affected service
echo ""
echo "=== Restart ${TARGET}-${SERVICE} ==="
ssh "root@${HOST}" "systemctl restart ${TARGET}-${SERVICE}.service" 2>&1

sleep 3

# 5. Check
echo ""
echo "=== Logs ==="
ssh "root@${HOST}" "journalctl -u ${TARGET}-${SERVICE}.service --no-pager -n 15" 2>&1

echo ""
echo "=== Health ==="
ssh "root@${HOST}" "curl -s http://localhost:9998/ 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null" || true
# open_taki config
listen: ":9998"

# LLM Backend (microllm or direct vLLM)
# model = meta stage: DocMeta, Summary, Entities, Store-Detect, Rescue, Chat
llm:
  api_base: "http://localhost:8012/v1"
  model: "local"
  max_tokens: 4096

# OCR stage model (grounded bbox OCR + VLM text OCR)
# Empty = use llm.model. Point this at a fast vision model that does
# bboxes well (e.g. a 27B) while meta runs on the quality model (e.g. 122B).
ocr:
  model: ""

# Collabora — office document conversion (DOC, XLS, PPT, ODT, ODS, ODP)
# If not set, only pandoc-supported formats work (DOCX, ODT, EPUB, RTF)
# Collabora is open source and available as container: collabora/code
collabora:
  url: ""  # e.g. "http://collabora:9980"

# Whisper Backend — audio/video transcription
whisper:
  api_base: ""  # e.g. "http://localhost:8019/v1"
  model: "whisper-large-v3"

# Embedding Backend
embedding:
  api_base: ""  # e.g. "http://localhost:8019/v1"
  model: "nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5"

# Vector DB
vector:
  url: ""  # e.g. "http://localhost:6333"
  collection: "documents"

# PDF
pdf:
  dpi: 150
  max_pages: 20

# pdftotext fallback
fallback:
  min_chars: 200
  min_chars_per_page: 50

# Structured metadata extraction from document letterheads
# Uses guided_json (constrained decoding) for deterministic extraction
# Schema, prompt and rescue prompt are loaded from external files.
# Edit those files to add/change metadata fields without rebuilding.
docmeta:
  enabled: true
  model_version: "qwen3-doctype-1.0"           # doctype model version (prompt + schema + types)
  rescue_pass: true                            # text-based fallback if vision pass incomplete
  required_fields: [doc.date, sender.company]  # trigger rescue if these are null
  schema_file: ""        # default: /etc/open_taki/docmeta_schema.json
  prompt_file: ""        # default: /etc/open_taki/docmeta_prompt.txt
  rescue_prompt_file: "" # default: /etc/open_taki/docmeta_rescue_prompt.txt

# OpenCloud (nur für den Ordner-Chat /chat/ask — WebDAV Public-Link-Shares)
# Pod-Mode: opencloud + tika teilen den Netz-Namespace => 127.0.0.1
opencloud:
  url: "http://127.0.0.1:9200"

# Ordner-Chat (POST /chat/ask): Tool-Loop, Modell liest Dateien selbst
# über einen ephemeralen Public-Link-Share (view, password, 1h)
chat:
  max_iterations: 20       # max. Tool-Schritte pro Frage
  default_model: ""        # default: llm.model
  max_file_chars: 60000    # read_file-Kappung
  max_listings: 300        # max. Einträge im rekursiven list_directory
  list_depth: 3            # max. Verzeichnisebenen im rekursiven list_directory
  system_prompt_file: ""   # default: /etc/open_taki/prompts/chat_system.txt (taka-prompts-Paket)

# Recording (near-live Transkription)
# Diarization via openannote (pyannote) über microllm Service-Proxy
recording:
  diarize_api_base: ""     # e.g. "http://microllm:8012/svc/steno-ml"
  diarize_model: ""        # e.g. "pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1" (leer = Default)
  speaker_store: ""        # SQLite-DB Pfad (leer = /data/speakers.db)
  max_chunk_mb: 50         # max. Audio-Chunk-Größe in MB
  session_dir: ".recordings"

# Routing (active with X-Taki-Protocol: v2)
routing:
  vector: always
  bleve_rules:
    - match:
        mime: ["application/pdf", "application/msword", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-*"]
      features: [docmeta, meta, entities, summary]
    - match:
        mime: ["image/*"]
      features: [docmeta, meta]
    - match:
        mime: ["application/vnd.ms-excel", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml*"]
      features: [meta]
    - match:
        mime: ["message/*"]
      features: [meta, entities]
    - match:
        mime: ["text/*"]
      features: []
    - match:
        space_type: ["project"]
        mime: ["*"]
      features: [docmeta, meta, entities, summary]
